title: Small roster repair with boundary-day obligations
hypothesis: Coverage and transition obligations must remain jointly feasible after a small schedule change.
why_hard: A cost threshold can distinguish valid repair from greedy coverage alone, but exact global search can add the wrong difficulty.
next_action: Only prototype if a small independent reference reaches the threshold in seconds.

sources.note: Primary source inspected 2026-09-12; motivation, not a model result.

notes: Existing public benchmark solutions are not copied. Large combinatorial search is outside this scope.
